newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-NORMAN LURKS BEHIND LEADING TRIO.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-NORMAN LURKS BEHIND LEADING TRIO.

text.p: World number one Greg Norman moved into contention in his own tournament on Saturday. A third round 69 at Royal Melbourne gave him a total of 213, just two behind joint leaders Peter Senior of Australia, American Jerry Kelly and New Zealand's Michael Long. Senior matched Norman's third round performance in strong winds and driving rain on a difficult day for scoring in the Greg Norman Classic. Long shot 70 and Kelly 72 for five-under-par totals of 211.

Norman, winner of his fifth Australian Open last weekend, said he hoped the weather remained cold and windy for the final round on Sunday. He believes he has an advantage because of his power off the tee and experience.
